# Site settings

Copy this note's frontmatter and adjust it. Every key is optional. This folder has a `.nopublish` marker, so the note
is never a page, but its values are written to `content/site.json`, which is committed and public: no secrets here.

Add `image: share.png` (a raster, about 1200x630, next to this note) to set the default social preview, and
`block-crawlers: [GPTBot, CCBot]` to disallow those user agents in `robots.txt`.
